notable_findings: policy-as-versioned-feeds org does not exist (never created, or name never matched).

policy-as-versioned-flux/policy: of 12 tags, 8 tag objects (v1.0.0,v1.0.1,v1.0.2,v1.0.3,v2.0.1,v2.0.2,v2.0.3,v2.1.1,v2.2.0,v2.2.1 -- see raw tag-signing-summary.txt for exact list) return verification.verified=false reason=bad_cert via gh api git/tags/<sha>, while v2.0.0 verifies true (reason=valid). Only 4 of 12 flux/policy tags verify. This is inconsistent with CLAUDE.md commit history claiming policy repo tags are 'fully gitsign-signed' (per a comment found in fleet's policy-versions.yaml) -- worth a closer look, not fixed here per read-only mandate.

All satellite/adopter org repos (driftwood, tuppence, ludlow, nist, ico, platform) tag as 'releases@<org>.invalid' via a release bot and show verified=false reason=no_user (sigstore/OIDC keyless signing not linked to a GitHub user identity -- expected pattern for CI-cut tags, not a defect).

flux/api, flux/c2p-collector, flux/handbook-generator, flux/ledger, flux/pr-gate-action, flux/readiness-collector, flux/reports, flux/storefront all show verified=true (tagger chris@cns.me.uk, reason=valid).

9 of 22 repos across all orgs have open PRs, all authored by app/renovate -- mostly dependency updates, plus 3 satellite orgs (ico, nist, platform) each have exactly one still-open 'Configure Renovate' onboarding PR from 2026-08-21 that has not been merged/closed.

Branch/tag rulesets exist only in the flux org: 'protect-release-tags' (tag ruleset) on 8 flux repos, 'require-pr-gate' (branch ruleset) on flux/fleet. No repo in the 6 satellite orgs (platform/driftwood/tuppence/ludlow/nist/ico) has any ruleset configured.

renovate.json present in 11 of 22 repos (all in the flux org's app/service repos + renovate-config repo pattern; satellite org repos rely on Renovate's default onboarding PR instead of a committed config).
apps repo in flux org is archived; not referenced by fleet's live GitOps tree -- confirmed superseded by the 5-repo team-repo split (ticket 07/08).
